steps.title: 建立高鐵系統邊界
steps.objective: 分開土建、軌道、供電、車輛、控制及營運介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate civil, track, power, vehicle, control and operations interfaces.
steps.instruction: 畫出土建承托軌道、軌道導引車輛的主鏈，再加供電與控制連到車輛。以不同箭頭表示力、能量與資訊，為每種介面列一項驗證問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw civil support to track to vehicle, then connect power and control to the vehicle. Use distinct arrows for force, energy and information, with one verification question per interface.
steps.observation: 觀察車輛能運轉是否仍不足以證明軌道與控制整合已完成。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a moving train alone does not establish completed track and control integration.
steps.failure: 把高鐵等同於一列高速列車，省略路線與控制條件。
steps.failureEn: Equating a high-speed railway with a fast train while omitting route and control conditions.
steps.check: 六個子系統都有介面，且箭頭的物理意義清楚。
steps.checkEn: Connect all six subsystems and explain the physical meaning of each arrow.

knowledge.title: 跨專業系統
knowledge.text: 高速運行取決於車輛與路線、供電、控制及營運的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed operation depends on compatibility among vehicles, route, power, control and operations.

knowledge.title: 不同傳遞量
knowledge.text: 力、電能與控制資訊需要不同驗證，不能用同一箭頭含糊表示。
knowledge.textEn: Force, electrical energy and control information require different verification and should not share an ambiguous arrow.

options: 與路線動態及控制系統相容
列車靜態寬度已被量測
尺寸文件有可比對的幾何內容
optionsEn: Compatibility with route dynamics and control
That static train width was measured
That the dimensional record contains comparable geometry
quiz.question: 列車靜態尺寸合格，還不能單獨證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: A train meets static dimensional requirements. What does that not establish by itself?
quiz.explanation: 靜態幾何只是整合條件的一部分，仍需動態與控制證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Static geometry is only part of integration; dynamic and control evidence remains necessary.

steps.title: 比較曲線與行車需求
steps.titleEn: Compare alignment curves and service needs
steps.objective: 理解速度、曲線與舒適性的相互約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand relationships among speed, curvature and ride requirements.
steps.instruction: 自繪直線、緩和曲線與圓曲線的概念路線，標出方向變化。比較兩種示意速度下需要關注的橫向反應，不指定實線設計半徑或超高。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch straight, transition and circular alignment sections, marking direction changes. Compare lateral-response concerns at two illustrative speeds without assigning real design radius or cant.
steps.observation: 觀察平面方向平順，是否仍有垂向坡度或接續問題。
steps.observationEn: Check whether a smooth plan alignment still leaves vertical-gradient or transition issues.
steps.failure: 只看列車最高速度，就認定所有曲線都能以同速通過。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every curve supports a train’s maximum rated speed.
steps.check: 交付平面及縱向問題各一項，說明缺少的驗證資料。
steps.checkEn: Provide one plan and one vertical-profile question with missing verification data.

knowledge.title: 速度與曲率
knowledge.text: 橫向運動反應取決於速度與曲率的組合，而非車輛標稱速度。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral motion depends on the combination of speed and curvature, not the vehicle’s rated speed alone.

knowledge.title: 平順接續
knowledge.text: 方向或坡度變化需要連續性考量，不能只把直線片段接起來。
knowledge.textEn: Direction and gradient changes require continuity considerations rather than simply joining straight segments.

options: 車輛靜態長度是否自行縮短
橫向動態反應與舒適性如何改變
既有曲線的幾何是否因速度而自動改變
optionsEn: Whether static vehicle length automatically shortens
How lateral response and comfort change
Whether curve geometry automatically changes with speed
quiz.question: 同一曲線提高示意速度時，最合理的研究問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: If illustrative speed increases on the same curve, which question is most relevant?
quiz.explanation: 速度變動改變動態需求；不能假定幾何或車輛尺寸會自行補償。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing speed alters dynamic demands; geometry and vehicle dimensions do not automatically compensate.

steps.title: 追蹤地層下陷到軌道
steps.objective: 分辨均勻沉降與差異沉降的介面影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish interface effects of uniform and differential settlement.
steps.instruction: 用同一條示意軌道畫均勻下降與局部下降兩種剖面。將地面觀測、橋墩位移與軌道高低資料列成三層，說明不能互相替代的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Draw uniform and localized settlement beneath the same illustrative track. Separate ground observations, pier movement and track levels into three evidence layers and explain their limits.
steps.observation: 比較總沉降相近的兩例，局部坡折是否不同。
steps.observationEn: Compare local gradient changes in examples with similar total settlement.
steps.failure: 以沿線平均沉降值代表所有局部軌道變化。
steps.failureEn: Using average line-wide settlement to represent every local track change.
steps.check: 指出最需補充局部量測的位置，並維持共同高程基準。
steps.checkEn: Identify locations needing local measurements and retain a common elevation datum.

knowledge.title: 差異變形
knowledge.text: 鄰近支承的相對變形會影響幾何連續性，不能只看平均值。
knowledge.textEn: Relative movement of neighboring supports affects geometric continuity and is not captured by an average.

knowledge.title: 跨層證據
knowledge.text: 地盤、土建與軌道的反應需對齊位置和時間才可比較。
knowledge.textEn: Ground, civil and track responses must share location and time references to be compared.

options: 所有支承一起均勻下降的一段必定較差
僅憑總沉降即可判定兩者完全相同
沉降集中在短距離內的一段
optionsEn: The uniformly settling section must be worse
Total settlement alone proves the sections identical
The section where settlement is concentrated over a short distance
quiz.question: 兩段總沉降相同，哪段仍可能有較大的幾何變化？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal total settlement. Which may still have greater geometric change?
quiz.explanation: 沉降的空間分布會改變坡度與曲率，即使總量相同。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial distribution changes slope and curvature even when total settlement is equal.

steps.title: 檢查橋梁與軌道支承介面
steps.objective: 把預鑄構件交接連到軌道幾何基準。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect precast-member handover to track-geometry references.
steps.instruction: 以自繪高架橋分開橋墩、支承、梁體與軌道層，標出縱向伸縮和量測基準。列出梁體就位後，軌道專業仍需取得的幾何與狀態資料。
steps.instructionEn: Separate piers, bearings, girders and track layers in a viaduct sketch. Mark longitudinal movement and survey references; list geometry and state records needed by the track team after girder placement.
steps.observation: 注意梁體就位合格不等於軌道精度與長期位移已被驗證。
steps.observationEn: Accepted girder placement does not establish track precision or long-term movement behavior.
steps.failure: 將橋梁竣工標高直接當成最終鋼軌標高，忽略中間構造。
steps.failureEn: Treating bridge as-built level as final rail level while omitting intermediate layers.
steps.check: 完成土建到軌道的介面表，至少含基準、可動方向與待補資料。
steps.checkEn: Complete a civil-to-track interface sheet including reference, movement direction and missing records.

knowledge.title: 層間累積
knowledge.text: 各層厚度、調整與變形共同決定鋼軌最終幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Layer thickness, adjustment and deformation together determine final rail geometry.

knowledge.title: 可動支承
knowledge.text: 設計允許的伸縮與需要限制的位移，應在模型中分清。
knowledge.textEn: Intended movement and movement that must be restrained should be distinguished in the model.

options: 中間層與調整量共同決定軌面位置
梁頂標高與軌面必定相同
軌道幾何與土建從不互相影響
optionsEn: Intermediate layers and adjustments determine rail position
Girder-top and rail elevations are necessarily identical
Track geometry and civil works never interact
quiz.question: 梁頂標高正確，為何還需軌道層交接資料？
quiz.questionEn: Why are track-layer records needed even if girder-top elevation is correct?
quiz.explanation: 交接要追蹤完整尺寸鏈，而不是只驗證其中一層。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover must trace the full dimensional chain, not only one layer.

stages.title: 路線與土建介面
stages.description: 將路線幾何、地盤與橋梁條件連到軌道需求。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect alignment, ground and bridge conditions to track requirements.

steps.title: 比較軌道形式及轉換區
steps.titleEn: Compare track forms and transition zones
steps.objective: 理解不同軌道形式回應不同介面要求。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how track forms respond to different interface needs.
steps.instruction: 依探索館說明，整理版式軌道、道岔附近的配置和低振動軌道三種功能重點。畫兩種剛度不同的軌道相接，列出需量測的幾何與動態反應。
steps.instructionEn: Using the museum overview, compare slab-track, turnout-area and low-vibration functions. Sketch a transition between track forms of different stiffness and identify geometric and dynamic observations.
steps.observation: 觀察靜態軌面平順是否仍可能有支承剛度變化。
steps.observationEn: Recognize that a smooth static rail profile can still cross a stiffness change.
steps.failure: 把全線軌道假定為單一材料與單一剛度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one material and stiffness for the entire line.
steps.check: 比較表須有功能、支承差異及轉換區待驗證事項。
steps.checkEn: Include purpose, support differences and transition-zone verification needs.

knowledge.title: 功能選型
knowledge.text: 道岔定位、一般正線與振動控制可能需要不同構造組合。
knowledge.textEn: Turnout positioning, ordinary main line and vibration control can require different structural arrangements.

knowledge.title: 過渡反應
knowledge.text: 支承特性突變可影響輪軌互動，需與幾何一起檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Abrupt support-property changes can affect wheel–rail interaction and should be examined with geometry.

options: 有，軌頂相同即代表剛度相同
沒有，支承特性與動態反應仍需證據
只要列車靜止不晃就已足夠
optionsEn: Yes; equal rail elevation means equal stiffness
No; support properties and dynamic response still need evidence
A stationary train not rocking is sufficient
quiz.question: 兩段軌頂高程相同，是否已證明轉換區動態相容？
quiz.questionEn: Two sections have equal rail elevation. Does that prove dynamic compatibility at the transition?
quiz.explanation: 高程只描述幾何的一部分，無法取代動態介面檢核。
quiz.explanationEn: Elevation describes only part of geometry and does not replace dynamic interface review.

steps.title: 分開道岔位置與路線確認
steps.titleEn: Separate turnout position from route confirmation
steps.objective: 辨識機械位置、位置證據與通行授權。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish mechanical position, position evidence and movement authority.
steps.instruction: 畫一個簡化分岔軌道，用不同符號表示移動部件、位置回報和控制狀態。寫出「位置未知」的桌上案例，說明為何不能只看遠景照片決定路線。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a turnout with separate symbols for moving components, position indication and control state. Describe an unknown-position tabletop case and why a distant photograph cannot establish a route.
steps.observation: 觀察部件看似靠妥與完整位置證據是否為不同層次。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish apparent mechanical closure from complete position evidence.
steps.failure: 將目視位置直接等同於系統已確認且允許列車通行。
steps.failureEn: Equating visual position with system confirmation and authority to move.
steps.check: 表格保留機械、檢知、控制三欄，未知狀態不得寫成已驗證。
steps.checkEn: Keep mechanical, detection and control columns separate; do not relabel unknown states as verified.

knowledge.title: 證據鏈
knowledge.text: 幾何位置、檢知資訊和系統授權屬於不同介面。
knowledge.textEn: Physical position, detection information and system authority are different interfaces.

knowledge.title: 未知狀態
knowledge.text: 資料不足不是正常的同義詞，應保留為待查證。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient information is not equivalent to normal operation and must remain unresolved.

options: 外觀可替代全部系統證據
可直接推論控制授權已成立
機械觀察已記錄，系統位置仍未驗證
optionsEn: Appearance replaces all system evidence
Movement authority can be inferred directly
Mechanical observation recorded; system position unverified
quiz.question: 道岔外觀位置正確但位置回報未確認，最合適的課程記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A turnout looks aligned but its position indication is unconfirmed. What is the best learning record?
quiz.explanation: 不同證據欄位不能互相冒充，未知應清楚留下。
quiz.explanationEn: Different evidence fields are not interchangeable; unknowns must remain visible.

steps.title: 建立集電與供電介面圖
steps.objective: 分辨供電存在與受電弓接觸品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish supply availability from pantograph contact quality.
steps.instruction: 自繪變電、電車線、受電弓與車輛用電鏈，另加接觸幾何示意。以「有電但接觸不穩」假想例子列出電氣與機械兩類證據，不提供接近帶電設備的作業。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch supply, catenary, pantograph and vehicle demand, adding contact geometry. For an invented energized-but-unstable-contact case, list electrical and mechanical evidence without field work near live equipment.
steps.observation: 比較上游供電量測與車上集電狀態能回答的不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Compare the questions answered by upstream supply readings and onboard collection observations.
steps.failure: 看到上游電壓正常就排除所有集電介面問題。
steps.failureEn: Ruling out every collection-interface problem because upstream voltage is normal.
steps.check: 每一個假說須連到電氣或機械證據，並註明位置與時間。
steps.checkEn: Link each hypothesis to electrical or mechanical evidence with location and time.

knowledge.title: 機電接觸
knowledge.text: 集電同時是電能傳遞與運動接觸問題。
knowledge.textEn: Current collection involves both electrical transfer and moving mechanical contact.

knowledge.title: 觀測位置
knowledge.text: 不同測點位於不同系統邊界，不能隨意互相替代。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements at different system boundaries cannot be substituted indiscriminately.

options: 該測點電壓在觀察期間穩定
受電弓全程接觸品質必定良好
所有車上負載均無異常
optionsEn: Voltage at that location was stable during observation
Pantograph contact was necessarily good throughout
Every onboard load was fault-free
quiz.question: 上游電壓穩定能直接證明哪項？
quiz.questionEn: What does stable upstream voltage directly establish?
quiz.explanation: 測量只能先支持其所在邊界與時間範圍內的結論。
quiz.explanationEn: A measurement initially supports conclusions within its own location and time boundary.

steps.title: 理解ATC速度防護證據
steps.objective: 區分行車計畫、允許速度與實際速度。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish timetable intent, permitted speed and actual speed.
steps.instruction: 自繪三條明確標成假想的曲線：計畫速度、允許速度、實際速度。找出實際速度接近或超出允許範圍的區域，說明需要防護而非只調整時刻表。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch explicitly fictional planned, permitted and actual speed curves. Identify where actual speed approaches or exceeds permission and explain the need for protection rather than merely changing the timetable.
steps.observation: 觀察晚點與違反速度限制是不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish lateness from violation of a speed limit.
steps.failure: 因列車晚點就把時刻表目標速度當成可突破的安全限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating a timetable target as permission to exceed a safety limit because the train is late.
steps.check: 標示三種曲線的來源角色與一個資料不足的區段。
steps.checkEn: Identify the role behind each curve and one section with insufficient information.

knowledge.title: 控制約束
knowledge.text: 允許速度受前方路線與行車條件影響，不只取決於車輛能力。
knowledge.textEn: Permitted speed depends on route and traffic conditions, not only vehicle capability.

knowledge.title: 安全與服務
knowledge.text: 準點目標與防護約束不是同一層級的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Punctuality objectives and protection constraints are different decision layers.

options: 計畫速度自動覆蓋允許速度
計畫需受當時允許範圍約束
只要實際速度低於車輛最高速度即可
optionsEn: Planned speed automatically overrides permission
The plan remains constrained by current permission
Actual speed need only remain below vehicle maximum
quiz.question: 計畫速度高於當時允許速度，應如何解讀課程圖？
quiz.questionEn: Planned speed exceeds current permitted speed. How should the diagram be interpreted?
quiz.explanation: 車輛能力與時刻表不能取代路線與行車防護條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Vehicle capability and timetable goals do not replace route and traffic protection conditions.

stages.title: 軌道與機電整合
stages.description: 辨識軌道形式、道岔、集電與控制的不同證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify distinct evidence for track forms, turnouts, current collection and control.

steps.title: 配對災害與偵測位置
steps.objective: 說明不同災害需要不同觀察量與布設邏輯。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain why hazards require different observables and siting logic.
steps.instruction: 自繪隧道口、跨河橋、邊坡及一般路段，將落石、水位、地滑、風與地震觀察配到合理區域。為每一配對補一句不能保證偵測所有事件的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a portal, river bridge, slope and ordinary section. Assign rockfall, water level, slope movement, wind and earthquake observations, noting one limitation for each.
steps.observation: 觀察單一感測器位置能代表的空間範圍是否有限。
steps.observationEn: Consider the spatial limits of any one detector location.
steps.failure: 認定只要全線裝有同一類感測器，就能覆蓋所有災害。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one detector type across the line covers every hazard.
steps.check: 完成至少四個「災害—位置—觀察量—盲點」配對。
steps.checkEn: Complete at least four hazard–location–observable–blind-spot mappings.

knowledge.title: 需求導向偵測
knowledge.text: 偵測器選擇與位置應回應特定事件如何影響路線。
knowledge.textEn: Detector type and location should respond to how a particular event affects the route.

knowledge.title: 覆蓋限制
knowledge.text: 沒有告警可能是未發生，也可能是超出覆蓋或設備狀態問題。
knowledge.textEn: No alarm may mean no event, an event outside coverage, or a device-state problem.

options: 遠方車站的室內溫度
其他路段道岔的位置回報
相關河段的水位與流況
optionsEn: Indoor temperature at a distant station
Turnout indication in another section
Water level and flow conditions in the relevant reach
quiz.question: 跨河橋的洪水風險，哪個觀察最直接相關？
quiz.questionEn: Which observation is most directly relevant to flooding at a river bridge?
quiz.explanation: 觀察量需對應災害機制與位置；不相關的正常訊號不能替代。
quiz.explanationEn: Observables must match hazard mechanism and location; unrelated normal readings are no substitute.

steps.title: 拆解地震後查證鏈
steps.objective: 區分告警、停止、檢查與恢復狀態。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish alarm, stop, inspection and restoration states.
steps.instruction: 以紙上流程排列事件紀錄、影響區段、設施檢查、資料複核與授權交接。為每一節點寫出輸入證據與未完成時的標記，不填真實復駛速度或門檻。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange event records, affected sections, inspections, evidence review and authorization handover on paper. Name input evidence and incomplete-state labels without actual restart speeds or thresholds.
steps.observation: 觀察地震訊號結束與設施已確認可用是否是不同時點。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish the end of shaking from confirmation that facilities are usable.
steps.failure: 因感測器恢復正常，就省略受影響土建與軌道的查證。
steps.failureEn: Skipping civil and track checks because sensor readings have returned to normal.
steps.check: 流程需顯示至少一個不能由感測器單獨證明的節點。
steps.checkEn: Show at least one stage that a sensor reading alone cannot verify.

knowledge.title: 事件與狀態
knowledge.text: 告警描述事件或觀察；設施狀態仍需其他證據確認。
knowledge.textEn: An alarm describes an event or observation; facility condition requires additional evidence.

knowledge.title: 分階段復核
knowledge.text: 停止、檢查與運行授權是不同責任，應各自留下紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping, inspection and operating authority are distinct responsibilities requiring records.

options: 不能，受影響設施與授權仍需查證
可以，事件結束等於設施無損
可以，只要列車沒有明顯外觀損傷
optionsEn: No; affected facilities and authorization still require verification
Yes; an ended event means undamaged facilities
Yes, if trains show no visible damage
quiz.question: 地震波已停止，能否單憑此資訊判定全線可恢復？
quiz.questionEn: Shaking has stopped. Does that alone establish line-wide readiness?
quiz.explanation: 事件停止不能證明每個結構、軌道與系統介面都仍符合要求。
quiz.explanationEn: An ended event does not establish that every structure, track and system interface meets requirements.

steps.title: 管理維護與零件變更證據
steps.objective: 理解相容性需要超過外形與料號。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why compatibility needs more than appearance and part numbers.
steps.instruction: 自設一個更換感測器的紀錄，包含功能、接線介面、校正、版本與測試結果。比較新舊元件，在每個差異旁列出需更新的文件。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a sensor-replacement record with function, connection interface, calibration, version and test result. Compare old and new items, noting documents that each difference requires updating.
steps.observation: 注意外形相同但量程、輸出定義或版本不同的情境。
steps.observationEn: Consider identical-looking parts with different ranges, output meanings or versions.
steps.failure: 只因安裝孔位相同，就認定替代零件已完成相容驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring a replacement compatible solely because mounting holes match.
steps.check: 交付功能差異表與可追溯的測試／文件清單。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a functional-difference table and a traceable test/document list.

knowledge.title: 配置管理
knowledge.text: 實際安裝狀態應與圖紙、設定及維護紀錄相符。
knowledge.textEn: Installed configuration should match drawings, settings and maintenance records.

knowledge.title: 相容性驗證
knowledge.text: 機械裝得上不代表電氣、資訊或功能語意相同。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical fit does not establish electrical, information or functional equivalence.

options: 僅沿用原先的單位標籤
核對接收端解讀、校正與文件
只確認外殼沒有損傷
optionsEn: Simply retain the old unit label
Review receiver interpretation, calibration and documentation
Only inspect the housing for damage
quiz.question: 新感測器孔位相同但輸出單位不同，最需要什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A new sensor fits mechanically but uses different output units. What is most needed?
quiz.explanation: 輸出語意是系統介面的一部分，不能由機械相容取代。
quiz.explanationEn: Output meaning is part of the system interface and is not verified by mechanical fit.

steps.title: 交付高鐵整合證據矩陣
steps.objective: 讓跨專業判斷有一致位置、版本與完成狀態。
steps.objectiveEn: Give cross-discipline judgments consistent location, version and completion state.
steps.instruction: 將土建、軌道、集電、ATC及災害圖表列成需求—證據矩陣。選一個橋梁沉降情境，追蹤它可能影響哪些介面，註明只屬學習分析。
steps.instructionEn: Build a requirement–evidence matrix for civil works, track, collection, ATC and hazards. Trace interfaces potentially affected by a bridge-settlement scenario, labeling it as a learning analysis.
steps.observation: 檢查某一系統的正常證據是否被誤用來替其他系統背書。
steps.observationEn: Check whether normal evidence for one subsystem is being used to certify another.
steps.failure: 只有各專業合格結論，缺乏交界處相容性的證據。
steps.failureEn: Collecting individual discipline approvals without evidence of compatibility at their interfaces.
steps.check: 每個介面都有來源、適用情境、未解問題及後續責任。
steps.checkEn: Give each interface a source, applicable scenario, open issue and follow-up responsibility.

knowledge.title: 整合驗證
knowledge.text: 子系統各自符合要求，仍須檢查連接後的共同功能。
knowledge.textEn: Individually compliant subsystems still require verification of their connected functions.

knowledge.title: 可追溯交付
knowledge.text: 共享位置與版本使不同團隊能重建同一項判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Shared location and version identifiers allow teams to reconstruct the same judgment.

options: 是否可以刪除全部介面測試
是否已證明所有未測情境都合格
相互連接後是否滿足共同功能
optionsEn: Whether every interface test can be removed
Whether all untested scenarios are thereby proven acceptable
Whether their connections meet shared functional requirements
quiz.question: 五個子系統各自通過單機測試，下一個合理問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Five subsystems pass standalone tests. What is the next reasonable question?
quiz.explanation: 整合行為可能不是單機測試的範圍，需另外的對應證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrated behavior may lie outside standalone tests and needs evidence of its own.

stages.title: 災害、維護與交付
stages.description: 把偵測、決策、現地複核與變更管理分成可追溯步驟。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate detection, decisions, inspection and configuration changes into traceable stages.

title: 台灣高速鐵路
summary: 以路線、橋隧、軌道、列車與安全控制的介面，理解高速鐵路整合與長期維護。
summaryEn: Understand high-speed railway integration and maintenance through interfaces among alignment, civil works, track, trains and safety control.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.
